recognize_zh: 這是長條圖而非形態圖：橫軸為 CLL 一線治療方案（chlorambucil、fludarabine、alemtuzumab、FC、FCR、FCM、RFCM），縱軸為病人百分比；藍色為 CR、綠色疊加為 MRD 陰性 CR，含 rituximab 的化學免疫療法 CR 與 MRD- 比例最高。
features: Stacked bar graph, not a morphologic image
Blue bars: complete response; green segments: MRD-negative CR
Chlorambucil and fludarabine monotherapy show low CR rates without reported MRD-negative CR
FCR, FCM and RFCM show the largest MRD-negative CR fractions (RFCM total about 80%)
describe_en: This stacked bar graph (Ghia, Hematology 2012) summarizes rates of complete response (blue) and MRD-negative complete response (green) after first-line therapy in CLL across trials. Response rates rise progressively from chlorambucil and fludarabine monotherapy through alemtuzumab and fludarabine-cyclophosphamide (FC) to chemoimmunotherapy regimens (FCR, FCM, RFCM), in which MRD-negative CR accounts for a substantial proportion of patients. The figure illustrates that more intensive and antibody-containing regimens achieve deeper responses, supporting MRD as a treatment endpoint. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.
